children: BofA Securities issued a research report on LI AUTO-W

, of which 3Q results beat. The broker was upbeat on overseas sales and estimated the company to return to profit in 4Q26. BofA Securities maintained its Neutral rating on LI AUTO-W. The H-share TP was cut from HKD58.9 to HKD53.8. The TP for Li Auto Inc.
ADR was lowered from USD15.1 to USD13.8.

In response to the 3Q results and latest guidance, the broker slightly adjusted its vehicle sales forecasts for 2026-28 and raised gross margin assumptions. It estimated a non-GAAP net loss of RMB3.2 billion in 2026 and a non-GAAP profit of RMB2.6 billion in 2027.
